reviewed_by: Codex manual GameNatives/Radare2 versus x86 candidate review, 2026-10-19

checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: Reviewed retail entry 0x004B0C60 and Windows x86 branch in mem_alloc.cpp with the GameNatives export and current Radare2 disassembly.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.rationale: numBytes and alignment are stack cdecl signed 32-bit inputs; allocation request LEA uses their raw bits plus 0x1c. Removed x86 negative-size early return and alignment clamp unsupported by retail instructions.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.rationale: Retail 0x004B0C71 LEA computes wrapped request; 0x004B0CBE uses raw+alignment+0x1b, then decrement/invert mask. Windows x86 sum now uses unsigned 32-bit addition and raw alignment. All 23 modeled success cases agree including alignment=-1 and positive non-powers of two.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.rationale: Reviewed five four-byte header slots and aligned back pointer. Live fixture compares payload/backpointer relations, allocation count, list header state and allocation requests. Host 64-bit layout is excluded.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.rationale: Retail Mem_AllocChunk, lazy Mem_InitHeapState and HeapList_Insert are executed with deterministic allocator boundary. This does not verify the real CRT heap or pool modes.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.rationale: Success return matches in all 23 cases. Failure branch retains summing walk, Error_Show and infinite loop; failure execution, negative sizes and overflow inputs remain untested and are explicitly outside this reviewed scope.

limitations: Only non-negative byte counts with allocation success were exercised; allocation-failure behavior was not compared.
The game process and CRT heap are not running; allocation APIs are deterministic angr boundary procedures.
Scope: modeled allocation success only; failure, negative sizes, integer-overflow inputs and host 64-bit branch remain unverified.
No independent second reviewer; status stays STRUCTURALLY_VERIFIED.
